concerns.text: Task T009 (Versioning) is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but explicitly depends on T002 (Directory creation) to ensure `state/projects/` exists. Parallel execution of T009 before T002 will cause a FileNotFoundError. T009 must be sequential after T002, not parallel.

Task T019 (Manual Review Queue) depends on T018 (Storage) and T015 (Token counts). However, T019 logic requires comparing 'degenerate' vs 'very_complex' variants. T013 (Prompt Generation) must complete for ALL variants before T019 can run. The current ordering implies T019 runs immediately after T018, but T018 might only contain partial data if T013 is still generating other variants. T019 must explicitly depend on the completion of T013 for all 5 variants.

Task T062 (Dependency Chain Depth) is listed in Phase 3 (US1) but T064 (Depth vs Performance) in Phase 5 (US3) depends on T062. T062 writes to `data/processed/prompt_variants.parquet`. T064 reads from it. The dependency is clear, but T062 is marked [P] (parallel). If T062 runs in parallel with T013 (Prompt Generation), it may read an incomplete or non-existent parquet file. T062 must be sequential after T013 and T018.

Task T020 (Correlation Check) writes to `data/results/analysis_summary.csv`. Task T040 (Final Stats) also writes to `data/results/analysis_summary.csv` and includes the correlation coefficient from T020. T040 must strictly follow T020. The current list places T020 in US1 and T040 in US3, which is correct, but T040's description says it includes 'the correlation coefficient from FR-013 (T020)'. If T020 fails or is skipped, T040 will fail. T040 must have an explicit dependency on T020.

Task T016 (Fetch HumanEval) is listed as a prerequisite for T013-T015, but T016 is placed AFTER T013-T015 in the task list order. While the text says 'MUST PRECEDE', the visual ordering in the list (T013, T014, T015, then T016) is confusing and violates the 'Producer before consumer' visual heuristic. T016 should be listed before T013.
